name: @flow/android
description: Android client: packages/web in a Capacitor shell on the desktop's host seam (docs/design/ANDROID.md, apps/android/README.md). No `build` or `test` script on purpose — `pnpm -r build` and the root `pnpm test` must not need an Android SDK or a `cap sync`; the APK and the JUnit tests are `apk:debug` / `test:android`, run by the android.yml workflow.

scripts.apk:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.apk:debug:dev: cross-env-shell FLOW_ANDROID_DEV=1 "cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug"
